title: [Bug] UI Freezing on Linux Environments with Claude Code 2.0.0/2.0.1
body:
**Bug Description**
When running claude-code 2.0.0 or 2.0.1 in Emacs or a shell on Linux, the UI kept freezing. It makes it completely unusable.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: konsole
- Version: 2.0.0 and 2.0.1
- Feedback ID: 340b6572-c5c7-4d9b-9e21-a414b61aedeb

**Errors**

It freezes. No CTRL+C or anything.
author: strichter
